Explore mode: MFI per cluster, and the composition of the embedding

Source: R/explore-figures.R
explore_mfi_composition.Rd

The explore counterparts of population_mfi_summary.csv and umap_composition.png, built by the same functions so the two modes read alike: explore_cluster_mfi.csv with its heatmap and dot plot, and explore_cluster_composition.csv with explore_umap_composition.png.

Usage

explore_mfi_composition(
  cells,
  feats,
  prof,
  subs = NULL,
  tr = NULL,
  thr_by_sample = list(),
  scatter = character(0),
  ex_dir,
  tag = ""
)

Arguments

cells

Explore cell table: sample_id, cluster, umap_1, umap_2, the feature columns and optionally group.

feats

Feature names.

prof

Cluster profile, with phenotype and frac_pos.* columns.

subs

Optional subset annotation from annotate_clusters_with_subsets().

tr

The panel's transform.

thr_by_sample

Named list: sample -> named thresholds on the analysis scale.

scatter

Feature names that are log10 scatter.

ex_dir

Output directory.

tag

Panel suffix.

Value

Character vector of file names written.

Details

Per-cluster medians are taken per SAMPLE first and summarised over samples, as for declared populations, so the donor with the most events does not set a cluster's intensity. A sample contributes to a cluster only where it holds at least ten of its cells. Percent positive is against each sample's own threshold where the declared run supplied one; otherwise the "All samples" row falls back to the cluster's pooled call, the basis explore_cluster_profile already reports.
